tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs pa dge legs 'phel// na maḥ.āryā tsa lā ya/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la dkyil dkrung bcas nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa mi g.yo bar gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na ma āryā tsa lā sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ āryā tsa lā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pādyaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dī paṃ gandhaṃ nai wi dyaṃ shapta pra tītstsha swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang 'bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarb+ba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus nas/ hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gi rje btsun mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa la rdo rje'i zhags pa dkris pa'i sne mo phrag gong du phyar ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa'i ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i g.yas pa steng du gzigs pas lha'i bu'i bdud tshar gcod cing /

g.yon 'og tu gzigs pas klu dang sa bdag 'joms pa/ dbus ma thad kar gzigs pas bgegs phra mo tshar gcod pa/ klu gnyan sa bdag dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar/ sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing / dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i pus mo gdan la btsugs shing / g.yas pa bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra mtshon gang ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po nas 'bru tsam de las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad khro bo mi g.yo ba'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyi oṃ badzī bhā ba a bhī ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ rang gi snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ bla ma yi dam gyi byin rlabs thugs rje nus mthu rang la thim par bsams nas/ oṃ tsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdud bzhi'i bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mi g.yo mgon po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces pa 'di ni don gnyer dag gis bskul ba'i ngor/

dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tsand+ra kīrti'o// ༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed/ seng gdong ma/ spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro ba spyi dang 'dra/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su padma nyi ma drag po dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can la phug 'dzin pa mgo bo g.yas phyogs su bstan nas 'gyel ba'i steng du/ rang gi sems yi ge hūm̐ sngon po yongs su gyur pa la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas tshur 'dus/ hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin pa g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje zhags pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis rang gi phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / sbrul chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra bhū ta a dhi pa ta ya akṣo bhya ki rī ṭi na sarba bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsa na utpa dā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ badzra phaṭa/ 'di'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho bzhin bya/ seng ge gdong can bsgom na/ srung 'khor yan sngar dang 'dra/ de'i dbus su padma nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi ro'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs nus mthu tshur bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dbu skra dang sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ mkha' spyod nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong dang / gnod byed thams cad bsregs shing tshar bcad/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥ shaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭa/ dge ba 'di yis sogs so/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed na maṇḍal la chos 'byung mthing nag gi dbus su tshon spungs bkod/ mchod pa g.yas skor/ gtor ma gru gsum dmar po bcas la bdag bskyed sngar bzhin mdun du'ang de ltar bskyed pa ma/ mchod bstod gtor ma phul/ rjes gnang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin byas la/ mthar gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas sngags dang bka' bsgo byed pa yin/ skyabs sems/ tshad med/ swa bhā was/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri pad zla'i steng du rang gi sems yi ge hrīḥdakar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi rab tu zhi ba'i nyams can/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sems can gyi don mdzad par bskul ba/ g.yas gnyis pas shel dkar gyi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis pas me tog padma dkar po'i yu ba bzung nas snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba' ིsteng na rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos mtshan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs shing /

sku la rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba mtshon pa'i phyir ri dwags kṛṣṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i nu ma g.yon bkab pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor cog can gyi spyi bor seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs te yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas bla ma de'i thugs rje byin rlabs rang la zhugs par bsam la/ shes pa khong glod nas/ 'di ltar bsam ste/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems yin la/ sems kyang thog mar skye ba'i rgyu btsal na mi rnyed pas/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid ces bya/ bar du sems rang gi ngo bo la brtag na phyi nang gi chos gang du yang ngos bzung med pas/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa zhes bya/ mthar 'gag pa'i 'bras bu gang du yang ma grub pas rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa zhes bya ste/ mdor na sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i 'od gsal rang rig pa'i ngang la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag go

/yang shes pa 'phro na chos thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin yang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can bdag 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa dam pos bcings pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du snying rje bsgom/ de gnyis re 'jog byas bsgom pa la thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa zhes bya ba'i ming 'dogs pa yin no/ /bsgom pas skyo na rang gi snying khar zla ba la hrīḥdakar po'i mtha' mar yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros te/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bdag la 'jug par bsam zhing / oṃ maṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar/ dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /gzhon nu nor bzang ji bzhin du/ /yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yis/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes byed shog /spyod lam thams cad du rang gang 'dug pa'i gnas nub phyogs bde ba can nam/ ri bo po tā la la sogs pa dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ gzugs cir snang thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i rang bzhin/ sgra ci grag pa thams cad gsang sngags yi ge drug pa'i ngo bo sems kyi rnam rtog thams cad thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag snyam pas 'gro chag nyal 'dug thams cad du dge ba'i bya ba la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i sgrub thabs chung ngu 'di rnams don du gnyer ba kha cig gi ngor/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yi ge tshad mar gyur pa rnams mi gsal ba gsal bar bya ba'i phyir du dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma bzhugs// skyabs sems/ rang skad cig gi tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ

'jig rten 'dren pa sogs/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta hā yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra/ arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ naiwidyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la/ gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddhohaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang / zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las ngan pa thams cad sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin thams cad kyi tshe'i dngos grub bsdus nas hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po padma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs shing / rin po che'i rgyan brgyad dang / dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe dpag med kyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badzrī bhā ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta a yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra/ arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhūpaṃ/

ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ naibidyaṃ/ shapta pra tītstsha swā hā/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus ngag yid kyi sdig dang sdug bsngal dang / /nad gdon bar chad mtha' dag nyer zhi nas/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal 'byor myur thob cing / /khyed zhal bdud rtsi'i dga' ston myong gyur cig /rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ rang gi spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar rtsa ro rkyang dbu ma gsum gzhibs nas drang por gnas pa/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar aṃ dmar po/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ de'i steng du hrīḥdamar po/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar skya/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lortsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dbus su dbu ma'i yas snar haṃ dkar po/ haṃ oṃ/ hrīḥ hūm̐/ aṃ rnams las 'od 'phros 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi mdangs chags pa'i rnam pas spyan drangs/ rang gi lus kyi 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa sbubs thams cad tshe'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang bas lus kyi bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas shing / sems bde stong gi ye shes su gyur te/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ rlung bum pa can khor gsum bzung / oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzi wāntā ye swā hā/ lnga brgya song rjes yang sngar gyi dmigs pa gsal btab nas rlung gsum 'dzin/ de ltar thun gcig la ci nus bzlas la bcom ldan 'das bdag gi tshe'i bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi zhing / 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i srog shing / mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan/ mi bshig pa'i rdo rje/ mi g.yo ba'i g.yung drung /

tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /sngags kyi grangs nyin re la a ma ra ṇi khri tsho re/ dgongs mo shes rab snying po brgya rtsa re/ kun gyi sngags 'bru 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa byed do/ /ces pa 'di ni yos lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris pa'o/ /e waṃ// ༄༅/ /rgyal dbang 'chi med mgon po yi/ /sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhugs// na mo a pa ra mi tā yurdzñā nā ya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ rang skad cig gi tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshe dpag med lha dgu la 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs kyi bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang / oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhūpaṃ/ ālokaṃ gandhaṃ/ naibidyaṃ/ shapta pratītstsha swāhā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bya/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje ra ba dang / dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i yongs su bskor bar gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ tshar gsum/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang /

gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng du/ gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang / dril bu g.yer kha dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / dar gyi chun 'phyang dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas mdzes pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang / gyen du rin po che'i dra mig seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod snam dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug dang / zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar ba'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du hrīḥdamar po re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe'i go 'phang la bkod/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / tshe'i dngos grub 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byung ba/ hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bdag nyid sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/

shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu padma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ byang shar du kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ shar lhor yon tan tshe dpag med/ lho nub tu ye shes tshe dpag med/ nub byang du mi g.yo tshe dpag med/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po padma rā ga ltar dmar zhing / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na/ 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gi bzhugs pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor cog can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas tshe dpag med lha dgu la sangs rgyas byang sems 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs kyi bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ oṃ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha thams cad kyi spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pa re res dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥ'i mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las ngan gyi sgrib pa sbyangs tshe dpag tu med pa'i skur byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshe'i dngos grub thams cad sngags phreng dang 'od dmar po'i rnam par byung nas/

rang gi lus kyi nang gang bas tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par gyur/ oṃ na mo bhrūm̐ a yurdzñā na tshe dang ye shes/ hrī/ a ro li ka 'khor ba 'jig hūm̐ hrīḥsnying po dang / oṃ tadya thā 'di lta ste/ a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na dpag du med pa/ tshe dang ye shes/ hrīḥhūm̐ bhruṃ swā hā/ ming gi snying po dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes dpag du med pa rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yu rdzñā na su bi nishtsitta te dzwa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya arhate sa myaksaṃ baddhā ya/ tadya thā 'di lta ste/ oṃ puṇye puṇye/ bsod nams ma gnyis/ mahā puṇye/ bsod nams chen mo/ a pa ri mi ta puṇye/ bsod nams dpag med ma/ a pa ri mi ta puṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi ta/ bsod nams ye shes dpag med tshogs bsags ma/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā pa ri shuddharm+ma te oṃ 'du shes thams cad yongs dag chos nyid ma/ ga ga na sa mudga te swa bhā ba bi shuddhe nam mkhar 'phags ma rang bzhin rnam dag ma/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ tshul chen yongs su bskor ba legs sbyin ma/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'di rnams brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci rigs bzlas la gong bzhin mchod pa dang / bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal dang longs spyod dang / /rig pa'i blo dang rnam grol shes rab sogs/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa/ /bdag la lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

tshe mi 'gyur ba'i srog shing / mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan/ mi shigs pa'i rdo rje/ mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung / tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod de brtan par bya/ rnal 'byor rgyud ltar na ye shes pa mdun du phyung la gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gzhal khang srung 'khor gyii lha rnams rang la bsdu'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs ltar na ye shes pa gshegs mi dgos pas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung 'khor la thim/ de gzhal yas khang / de 'khor gyi lha rnams la/ de rang gtso bo la bsdu/ rang nyid dam ye dbyer med gyi ngang la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dge rtsa bsngos la/ spyod lam thams cad du tshe dpag med kyi nga rgyal gyi sher phyin gyi mdo bklag pa dang tsha tsha gdab pa/ srog blu sogs tshe bsring ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang shel dkar rdzong nas/ lha cig sangs rgyas skyabs mas bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal sa skya lo tsa ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ na mo badzra bi dā ra ya/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sgrub par 'dod na/ stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi 'dug stabs kyi gnas nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas nas/ rang nyid rdo rje rnam 'joms su gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon de las 'od 'phros bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnam 'joms la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ

na mo badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ tshar gsum/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gi mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon 'khon grib mi gtsang ba'i tshogs sbyangs/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo khro mo'i byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang khu ma rgad lta bu'i 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ shin tu brjid cing sprul pa du ma 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ ljang sngon/ /de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ oṃ badzri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing / dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ ljang sngon gyi mtha' mar gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su skor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las ngan sbyangs/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer ljang sngon gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib 'khon grib 'bags btsog mi gtsang ba rnams byang zhing dag par gyur/ na mashtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang snying 'di brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas shing / gzungs ring bzla bar 'dod na zur du shes par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las ngan 'khon grib 'bags btsog mi gtsang ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces pa 'di dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rgyal bu lhun grub rab brtan gyi don du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tsand+ra kīrti'o/ /maṅgalaṃ// ༄༅/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor khams gsum bdud las rnam rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na maḥshrī badzra mahā kā lā pa/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa lan bdun/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung 'khor bsgom par bgyi'o/

/tshar gsum/ rang skad cig gis dpal gur gyi mgon por gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa/ dbu'i cha la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shapta pra tītstsha swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i sogs tshad med bzhi tshar gcig oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las suṃ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong zur gsum pa stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i steng du/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer la rdo rje dang / me ris 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du/ padma dang nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ las gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ kha dog dmar nag go skabs med par 'khor ba'i dbus dang phyogs bcur padma dang nyi ma ro gdan re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ phyogs bcu'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

dbus su rang nyid skad cig gi dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang / g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇṭi bsnams shing / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po bcu po thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du/ rdo rje gri gug yu bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shapta pra tītstsha swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa re res dbu rgyan/ rang gi snying kha'i gri gug gi yu ba'i hūm̐ gi mtha' skor du/ rang gi ming dang de'i mthar yi ge bcu gnyis pa/ bdun pa/ rtsa sngags rnams kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad phyir bton/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam gyis gtams par bsam/ gzhan bsrung bya bsgom na/ hūm̐ gi mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su bu dang chung ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog 'og tu nor rdzas khang gzhis sogs yod par bsam/ yang 'od 'phros khro bo bcu srung 'khor dang bcas pa la phog de thams cad las las mkhan mtshon cha thogs pa dang bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros/ stong gsum gyi khams thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan 'dzin dang / rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad mes bsregs/ mtshon chas btubs/ sha khrag las mkhan rnams kyis zos/ rnam par shes pa chos kyi dbyings su yal/ rang la byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad byas pa thams cad mes bsregs shing rlung gis gtor bar yang bsam la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi ge bdun pa gnyis phreng skor re tsam bzlas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa no pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ye ṣa a pashtsi ma/ kā lo3.a di dwaṃ ratna tra ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ ya di twaṃ pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si tā da i daṃ duṣṭaṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ banda banda/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'di nyung na nyi shu rtsa gcig mang na brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi/
